rule_text.name: 702.221a
rule_text.rule: Orchestrate represents a static ability of a card in your hand that creates a delayed triggered ability. “Orchestrate (cost)” means “At any time you could cast a sorcery, you may pay (cost) and exile this card from your hand. If you do, when you next resolve a spell, cast this card from exile without paying its mana cost.”

rule_text.name: 702.221b
rule_text.rule: Exiling a card for its orchestrate cost is a special action and can't be countered.

rule_text.name: 702.221c
rule_text.rule: If the triggered ability created by orchestrate is countered, the card will remain in exile and the ability allowing you to cast it won't trigger anymore.
